result:
TM-B13 / D-18 is in place. A save now fails before anything is written to disk when a custom INFO field can't be written, and every failing ID appears in the error. The full gate passes (exit 0). The mutation checks (R8-2) and the real-app runs (R8-4/5/6) are still for C.

**What changed (only the three files I own):**
- **`src/main/ipc/metadata.ts`** (+6/−4 lines):
  - The custom INFO loop no longer swallows `setValuesFromStrings` errors. It still tries every field, collects each failing ID in schema order, and throws `RIFF INFO fields could not be written: <IDs>` before `file.save()`.
  - The `// InfoTag read failed, use default` comment is gone and that block is now `catch {}`. Read behaviour is unchanged.
  - The D-17 guard, the error mapping and the title workaround are untouched. `grep '//'` on the file finds nothing.
- **`tests/main/metadata-write-field-errors.test.ts`** (new): the six task cases (a)–(e) plus two additions after code review:
  - **New case (f):** `meta:read` with the bad schema returns `''` for the bad field and keeps `category`.
  - **(d) meta key order swapped:** this shows the IDs come out in schema order, not input order.
- **`docs/recording-tag-contract.md`** (+11, nothing else changed): a Georgian section on all-or-nothing saves covering the five points from the task.

**What I ran:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Red: new test + `metadata-write-guard` against `28ad3ab`'s `metadata.ts` in `/tmp` | 3 failed, 8 passed (11). Exactly (a), (c1) and (d) fail |
| Green: same command on the real tree | 11/11 |
| Full `verifyCommand` from a clean state | exit 0 |
| Biome | 0 errors, 9 warnings (also 9 on `28ad3ab`, none in `metadata.ts`) |
| Typecheck (node/web/test) | 0 errors |
| Tests | renderer 107/107, main 62/62 (55 + 7 new), E2E 7/7 |
| E2E with `--retries=0` | 7/7 |
| Paths outside ownership | unchanged against `28ad3ab`; `git status` shows only the three owned paths |

**Code review:** the code-reviewer agent found no code defects. It reviewed the test file before I added (f) and swapped (d); both changes then went through the full gate. I also took its wording fix in the docs: the ID must be 4 bytes (4 ASCII characters).

**Acceptance:** I passed R8-1, R8-3 and R8-7 myself. R8-2 and R8-4/5/6 were not run by me (realVerified=false on my side).

**Known gaps:**
- **Test count for C:** the file has 7 tests, not 6. The R8-1 red/green run therefore totals 11, not 10; (f) passes in both. I flagged this in the report.
- **Case (a) sends no `title`:** I kept the task's exact input. The unchanged file bytes already show nothing was written.
- **Docs header and "შემოწმება" section:** they don't mention D-17/D-18 or the new test, because the task said not to change the rest of the document.
- **4-character non-ASCII IDs:** the library only checks the ID's length, so such an ID won't trigger D-18. That belongs with B-R7-02 (validating `riffChunkId` when the schema loads).

Everything is in `tmp/tag-manager-loop/`:
- `a-round-8.md`
- `a-round-8/checkpoint.md`
- `a-round-8/red-before-fix.log`
- `a-round-8/green-after-fix.log`
- `a-round-8/verify.log`
- `a-round-8/e2e-retries0.log`

STATUS: DONE
